# Fujin UI Toolset
> Mantine v7-based UI component library for web and React Native projects.
> All components are token-driven, sharp-edged, and workstation-focused.

## Repository Structure
- `tokens.json`         — DTCG token source. Single source of truth for all design values. Hand-authored.
- `dist/`               — GENERATED build outputs (tokens.css, tokens.js/.d.ts, mantine-theme.js/.d.ts, tokens-resolved.json). Committed; never hand-edited.
- `components/`         — Web UI components (Mantine v7)
- `native/`             — React Native primitive set + native token injection layer (useTokens)
- `themes/`             — Thin re-export of the generated module (`palette.ts`) + Mantine preset assembly (`createFujinTheme.ts`)
- `scripts/`            — Style Dictionary build (`build-tokens.mjs`), custom formats, build verification
- `AGENTS.md`           — Part A: consumer contract. Part B: in-repo agent guide.
- `CONSUMERS.md`        — Ledger of downstream consumers; defines what does NOT count as consumption
- `llms-full.txt`       — Full component API reference and usage examples (native surface: section 6)

## Core Rules (Non-Negotiable)
1. All colors, spacing, radius, and typography MUST come from the generated token module (`import tokens from '../dist/tokens.js'`). No hardcoded values. Never import `tokens.json` directly in a component — it is DTCG source, so its leaves are `{$value, $type}` objects rather than values.
2. All `borderRadius` MUST be `tokens.radius.default` (value: 0). Sharp edges everywhere. Note: Mantine's `defaultRadius: 0` does NOT reach eleven components whose radius is hardcoded upstream — the generated Mantine theme pins those explicitly. See DECISIONS.md.
3. Fujin colors are delivered via CSS custom properties (`var(--fujin-*)`), NOT via Mantine's color system. A generated Mantine theme IS applied — it exists to make Mantine's own internals agree with Fujin's tokens, not to deliver Fujin colors. (This rule previously read "No Mantine theme override"; that absolute was stale — see DECISIONS.md → "Superseded: No Mantine Theme Override".)
4. All color references in components MUST use `var(--fujin-*)` CSS custom properties — never a palette value directly.
5. Progressive disclosure: if a card has >2 actions, overflow into `ActionMenu`. If a workflow has >3 steps, use `WorkflowStepper`.
6. Changing a token means: edit `tokens.json`, run `npm run verify`, commit the source AND the regenerated `dist/`.

## Token Contract Summary
- Palette:    Slate (10-step, dark-first)
- Spacing:    4px base, scale: xs(10) sm(12) md(16) lg(20) xl(24) xxl(32)
- Typography: Verdana → system font stack; JetBrains Mono for monospace
- Radius:     0 on all sizes
- Themes:     Dark + Light (CSS custom properties via FujinThemeProvider; toggle with useFujinTheme)

## Component Index
- `ToolShell`        — App shell with collapsible left rail navigation
- `DataCard`         — Card with progressive disclosure and action overflow
- `WorkflowStepper`  — Multi-step workflow with per-step validation
- `FormShell`        — Form layout wrapper with error display and submit state
- `StatusBadge`      — Status indicator badge (success/danger/warning/info/neutral)
- `ActionMenu`       — Standalone overflow action menu (⋯ trigger)
- `SectionHeader`    — Panel/section header with optional right-side action slot
- `DataTable`        — Sortable, paginated data table with loading and empty states
- `FujinToastProvider` — Imperative toast notification system via context and portals

## Import Path

In-repo:
```ts
import tokens from '../dist/tokens.js';
import {
  ToolShell, DataCard, WorkflowStepper, FormShell, StatusBadge,
  ActionMenu, SectionHeader, DataTable, FujinToastProvider, useToast
} from './components';
import type {
  NavItem, CardAction, WorkflowStep, FormShellProps,
  DataColumn, SortDirection, ToastOptions, ToastStatus
} from './components';
```

Downstream (installed from a git tag — see AGENTS.md Part A):
```ts
import tokens, { resolveDark } from '@fujin/ui';
import { createFujinMantineTheme } from '@fujin/ui/mantine';
import '@fujin/ui/tokens.css';
```

## Agent Boundaries
- Fujin: UI components, tokens, layout, progressive disclosure logic
- Raiden: File structure, scaffolding, CI/CD, backend integration
